data.title: Phinia Names Gordon Muir Chief Financial Officer as Chris Gropp Retires
data.description:
By Colin Kellaher

Phinia's top finance executive, Chris Gropp, is retiring early next year from the developer of fuel systems, electrical systems and aftermarket solutions.

Phinia on Friday said Gordon Muir, who currently serves as treasurer, will succeed Gropp as senior vice president and chief financial officer of the Auburn Hills, Mich., company on Jan. 1.

Muir joined BorgWarner in 2007 and has been with Phinia since its spinoff in 2023.

Phinia said Gropp, who has been finance chief since the spinoff, will stay on as a special adviser until he retires at the end of March.

Write to Colin Kellaher at colin.kellaher@wsj.com

data.title: Buckle's 3Q Profit Slips Despite Higher Sales
data.description:
By Connor Hart

Buckle reported slightly lower profit in the recent quarter, even though net sales edged higher.

The apparel retailer on Friday posted a fiscal third-quarter profit of $48 million, or 94 cents a share, compared with $48.7 million, or 96 cents a share, a year earlier.

Net sales ticked up 2.6% to $329.2 million, benefiting from a 0.6% gain in comparable-store sales.

Online sales decreased 1.4%, to $52.2 million. Cost of sales increased 2.9%, to $171.9 million.

Write to Connor Hart at connor.hart@wsj.com

data.description:
RNS Number : 1104E Dotlines Global Limited 20 November 2026  

LEI: 213800L6HSNUEFYY3J85

20 November 2026

Dotlines Global Limited

(“Dotlines” or the “Company”)

Issue of equity and total voting rights

Dotlines (AIM: DOTL), the UK-based international technology group with operations across the UK and Southeast Asia spanning telecommunications, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and financial technology, announces that as agreed at the time of the Company’s admission to AIM (“Admission”) it will issue 398,309 new ordinary shares of no par value in the Company (“Ordinary Shares”) to Kane Black, a former director of the Company (the “Accrual Shares”).

As set out in the Company’s AIM admission document dated 20 April 2026 (the “Admission Document”) and subject to a deed of indemnity provided by Mr Black, the Accrual Shares would be issued six months following Admission at 9.5 pence per share in satisfaction of director fees and expenses incurred prior to Admission.

Mr Black has agreed that, for a period of six months from the date of issue, he will not dispose of any of the Accrual Shares except in accordance with certain orderly market principles, subject to certain exceptions.

Admission to AIM

The Company will now proceed to issue the Accrual Shares and application has been made to the London Stock Exchange for the 398,309 Accrual Shares to be admitted to trading on AIM on or around 24 November 2026 (“Accrual Shares Admission”). The Accrual Shares will rank pari passu in all respects with the Company’s existing Ordinary Shares.

Total voting rights

Following Accrual Shares Admission, the issued share capital of the Company will comprise 610,567,984 Ordinary Shares. Each Ordinary Share has one voting right and no Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. Accordingly, from the date of Accrual Shares Admission, the total number of voting rights in the Company will be 610,567,984. This figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Financial Conduct Authority’s Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.

About Dotlines

Dotlines Global Ltd (AIM: DOTL) is a UK-based international technology group operating in the telecommunications, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity and financial technology sectors. Founded in Malaysia in 2007 as a bespoke B2B software development business, it has since grown to offer a range of products, platforms and solutions for both B2B and B2C customers. Its two core areas of activity are digital content and services – principally, the Sohoj digital lifestyle platform for migrant populations in Malaysia, which has served over a million migrants from countries across Asia – and telecom products and services in the UK comprising: the Catena OSS and BSS software platform for internet service providers; Audra SME- and consumer-focused cybersecurity solutions; and the Carnival Internet full fibre broadband service.

data.title: Cizzle Brands Corporation Announces Pricing of US$15,150,000 Public Offering and Nasdaq Listing
data.description:
Cizzle Brands Corporation (Cboe Canada: CZZL; OTCQB: CZZLF; Frankfurt: 8YF) (“Cizzle Brands” or the “Company”), the sports nutrition company that is elevating the game in health and wellness, today announced the pricing of its underwritten public offering (the “Offering”) in connection with the uplisting of its common shares to the Nasdaq Capital Market. The Company is offering 3,030,000 common shares at a public offering price of US$5.00 per share. The Company has also granted the Underwriter (as defined below) a 45-day option to purchase up to an additional 454,500 common shares, representing 15% of the common shares sold in the Offering. The common shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market on November 20, 2026 under the symbol “CZZL.”

The gross proceeds from the Offering, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other estimated Offering expenses payable by the Company, are expected to be approximately US$15.15 million, excluding any exercise of the Underwriter’s option to purchase additional shares. The Offering is expected to close on or about November 23, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.

The Company intends to use the net proceeds of the Offering for repayment of a portion of the indebtedness incurred to finance its acquisition of Flow Water Inc.’s beverage co-manufacturing business; capital expenditures to expand production capacity at The CWENCH Hydration Factory in Aurora, Ontario, including additional Tetra Pak aseptic filling and packaging capacity and related plant and equipment; and general corporate purposes, including ongoing operations, working capital and growth initiatives. However, the Company’s management will have broad discretion with respect to the actual use of the net proceeds from the Offering.

Joseph Gunnar & Co., LLC (the “Underwriter”) is acting as sole book-running manager for the Offering. Research Capital Corporation is acting as an agent for the sale of common shares in the Offering in Canada.

A registration statement on Form F-10 (File No. 333-298427) related to the Offering of the common shares described above was filed with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) and became effective on September 29, 2026 pursuant to Rule 467(b) under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended. A copy of the registration statement can be accessed by visiting the SEC website at www.sec.gov. The common shares are being offered and sold in the United States only by means of a prospectus supplement and the accompanying short form base shelf prospectus dated October 7, 2025, forming part of the registration statement. A final prospectus supplement relating to this Offering will be filed with the SEC. When available, a copy of the final prospectus supplement and accompanying base shelf prospectus may be obtained from Joseph Gunnar & Co., LLC, Prospectus Department, 40 Wall Street, 30th Floor, New York, NY 10005, telephone 212-440-9600, email: prospectus@jgunnar.com Investors may also obtain these documents at no cost by visiting the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov and under the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

Before you invest, you should read the prospectus and other documents the Company has filed or will file with the SEC for more complete information about the Company and the Offering.

As previously disclosed, a portion of the Offering is being raised in Canada in reliance on the “listed issuer financing” exemption from the prospectus requirements available under Part 5A.2 of National Instrument 45-106 - Prospectus Exemptions, as modified by Coordinated Blanket Order 45-935 - Exemptions from Certain Conditions of the Listed Issuer Financing Exemption (the “Listed Issuer Financing Exemption”). An amended and restated offering document containing final pricing for the Offering (the “Offering Document”) can be accessed in English and French under the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on the Company’s website at www.cizzlebrands.com. Prospective investors in Canada should read the Offering Document before making an investment decision concerning the common shares. Any distribution of common shares outside of Canada will be made pursuant to applicable foreign securities laws and the public offering exemption available under BC Instrument 72‑503 – Distribution of Securities outside British Columbia.

The Company also confirms that the consolidation of its outstanding common shares on the basis of one (1) post-consolidation common share for every twenty-five (25) pre-consolidation common shares (the “Consolidation”) has taken effect as of November 20, 2026. Trading of the post-Consolidation common shares on Nasdaq and Cboe Canada is expected to commence on November 20, 2026 under the existing symbol “CZZL.” The Company’s common shares will trade under a new CUSIP number (17888V201) and ISIN (CA17888V2012). The exercise price and the number of common shares issuable under the Company’s outstanding warrants and options will be proportionately adjusted to reflect the Consolidation. Fractional shares created as a result of the Consolidation will be rounded down to the nearest whole share.

Following the Consolidation and assuming no additional issuances, the Company expects to have approximately 9,217,365 common shares issued and outstanding, prior to rounding for fractional shares and prior to giving effect to the Offering.

In connection with the Consolidation, the Company will not require a letter of transmittal from holders of common shares whose shares are held in book-entry or DRS form. All such shareholders will automatically receive the post-Consolidation Shares to which they are entitled, and Odyssey Trust Company, as transfer agent, will distribute the applicable DRS statements. Odyssey Trust Company has confirmed that all common shares of the Company held by registered shareholders as of the effective date on November 20, 2026 will be processed. The Consolidation remains subject to the policies of Cboe Canada.

The Company also announced that it intends to extend the expiry date of 36,419,635 outstanding common share purchase warrants (on a pre-Consolidation basis) that are currently scheduled to expire at 5:00 p.m. (Toronto time) on November 28, 2026 (the “Warrants”) by 12 months, to November 28, 2027 (the “Warrant Extension”). The Warrants were originally scheduled to expire on August 28, 2026, and their expiry date was previously extended to November 28, 2026. All other terms of the Warrants, including the exercise price of $0.40 per share (on a pre-Consolidation basis, subject to adjustment in accordance with their terms, including for the Consolidation) and the Company’s right to accelerate the expiry date, will remain unchanged. The Warrant Extension has been approved by written resolution of disinterested shareholders in accordance with the policies of Cboe Canada and remains subject to acceptance by Cboe Canada.

About Cizzle Brands Corporation

Cizzle Brands Corporation is a vertically integrated sports nutrition company that is elevating the game in health and wellness. Through extensive collaboration and testing with leading athletes and trainers across several sports, Cizzle Brands has launched three game-changing brands: (i) CWENCH Hydration™, a better-for-you sports drink that is now carried in over 6,900 locations in Canada, the United States, and Europe; (ii) Spoken™ Nutrition, a premium brand of athlete-grade nutraceuticals that carry the prestigious NSF Certified for Sport® qualification; and (iii) HappiEats™, upgrading everyday eats with high-performance foods such as Sport Pasta™ and SnakStars™ Sport Bites. It also owns and operates The CWENCH Hydration Factory, a manufacturing facility that produces CWENCH Hydration and other leading beverage brands in Tetra Pak packaging. All Cizzle Brands products are designed to help people of all ages achieve their best in competitive sports and in living a healthy, vibrant, active lifestyle.

For more information about Cizzle Brands, please visit: https://www.cizzlebrands.com

For more information about CWENCH Hydration™, please visit: https://www.cwenchhydration.com

For more information about Spoken™ Nutrition, please visit: https://www.spokennutrition.com

For more information about HappiEats™, please visit: https://www.myhappieats.com

data.title: Bulletin from the Extraordinary General Meeting of Freemelt Holding AB (publ)
data.description:
Freemelt Holding AB (publ) (the “Company”) held an extraordinary general meeting today, 20 November 2026, at which the shareholders passed the following resolutions. The notice convening the extraordinary general meeting and the full proposals for resolutions are available on the Company’s website, www.freemelt.com.

Resolution on approval of the Board of Directors’ resolution on a rights issue of shares

The extraordinary general meeting resolved, in accordance with the Board of Directors’ proposal, to approve the Board of Directors’ resolution of 2 November 2026 regarding a new issue of a maximum of 151,799,640 shares with preferential rights for the Company’s existing shareholders (the “Rights Issue”). The subscription price is SEK 1.00 per share. Upon full subscription, the Company will raise approximately SEK 151.8 million before issue costs, and the share capital will increase by a maximum of SEK 7,589,982.00. Each existing share in the Company entitles the holder to one (1) subscription right, and three (3) subscription rights entitle the holder to subscribe for two (2) new shares. The record date for entitlement to subscription rights is 24 November 2026. Subscription for shares, with or without the exercise of subscription rights, shall take place during the period from 26 November 2026 up to and including 10 December 2026. The Board of Directors is entitled to extend the subscription period and postpone the payment date.

Resolution on authorisation for the Board of Directors to resolve on a new issue of shares to guarantors

The extraordinary general meeting resolved, in accordance with the Board of Directors’ proposal, to authorise the Board of Directors, for the period until the next annual general meeting, on one or more occasions, with deviation from the shareholders’ preferential rights and with or without conditions regarding set-off or other conditions, to resolve on a new issue of shares to those who have provided guarantee commitments in the Rights Issue. data.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
data.description:
By Niket Nishant

Anthropic's post-listing slide deepened the gloom over the AI sector on Friday, underscoring how even one of the most eagerly anticipated listings in history has struggled to revive investor enthusiasm.

Widely seen as a proxy for the AI trade, Anthropic's listing had been viewed as a potential boost for an industry struggling to regain momentum after a turbulent stretch.

But the stock was last trading at $88.87, about 9% below where it closed following Thursday's smooth debut, giving Anthropic a fully diluted valuation of about $1.6 trillion and a market capitalization of $1.2 trillion based on shares outstanding.

The stock could find support later in the year. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates index-tracking funds could account for purchases of up to 30% of Anthropic's shares by year-end.

Near-term volatility, however, could persist as the initial euphoria around the listing fades and investors assess whether a valuation of about 40 times sales over the past 12 months can be sustained.

"We favor patience on Anthropic and recommend evaluating the company as it reports public results," said Kaush Amin, head of private market investing at US Bank Asset Management, adding that the current valuation "assumes years of rapid growth."

The debut has also done little to ease broader concerns about the health of the AI trade. Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Thursday, while futures pointed to further declines on Friday.

Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Nvidia and Meta Platforms fell more than 2% each in premarket trading, while Amazon and Microsoft dropped more than 1%.

Chip stocks also slid, with AMD and Sandisk down 7% each and Intel losing more than 5%.

The focus now shifts to a potential OpenAI listing, which would be another major test of investors' appetite for AI stocks. OpenAI has indicated it may go public next year.

PARALLELS WITH SPACEX

Anthropic's IPO has drawn parallels with Elon Musk's SpaceX , which went public in June after the second-biggest IPO on record.

While the companies have different business models, some investors have pointed to SpaceX's sharp swings in the weeks after its debut as a reason for caution over buying Anthropic immediately after its listing.

"There's going to be some volatility like we had with SpaceX. A lot of people are going to have FOMO. I don't think there's any need to get on it on the first trade," said Rob Hackel, CEO of financial advisory and brokerage firm RF Lafferty & Co.

SpaceX shares fell about 5%.

Retail investors traded about $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012.

The stock's sharp swings have left investors weighing whether to bet on a rebound or brace for further losses. Options trading, due to begin next week, could add to the volatility.

"It's not a good environment for Anthropic at the moment," said Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Berenberg.

Competition could also weigh on investor sentiment.

Apple is developing an AI agent that can perform tasks on behalf of users, entering a market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.

data.title: Alibaba’s AI Outlook Draws Mixed Analyst Views: What Citi And Barclays Are Saying
data.description:
Key points:
  • Citi cut its price target to $160 from $193 while maintaining a ‘Buy’ rating, citing a broader sector de-rating.
  • Yesterday, Jefferies lowered its price target to $161 from $192 while maintaining a ‘Buy’ rating, but expects cloud revenue growth to recover to more than 50% in FY29, according to TheFly.
  • Alibaba's AI Cloud and Compute Services revenue grew 53% year-over-year in the September quarter, while E-commerce Group adjusted EBITA surged 243%.

Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. (BABA) shares traded marginally higher in premarket trading on Friday, after falling for two consecutive weeks, as multiple analysts weighed fresh commentary on the company's AI and cloud outlook following its quarterly results.

According to TheFly, Barclays lowered the firm's price target on the stock to $155 from $200, while maintaining its ‘Overweight’ rating. The revised target implies around 86.1% upside potential from the stock’s last close.

Barclays also stated that Alibaba had scaled back its AI compute capacity expansion ambitions following the latest U.S. restrictions on Chinese companies, describing the move as a potential “blessing in disguise,” TheFly reported.

Citi And Jefferies Weigh In On Alibaba's Outlook

According to TheFly, Citi lowered its price target on Alibaba to $160 from $193 while maintaining a ‘Buy’ rating, citing a broader sector de-rating. The firm also described Alibaba's revised cloud outlook as ‘pragmatic’ amid evolving compute export restrictions, adding that the changes do not alter the company's long-term AI ambitions.

On Thursday, Jefferies also lowered its price target on Alibaba to $161 from $192 while maintaining a ‘Buy’ rating, according to The Fly. The firm expects cloud segment revenue growth to accelerate in the December quarter, then slow to 30% to 45% year-over-year in fiscal 2028 and recover to more than 50% in FY29.

Jefferies also noted that Alibaba's planned investment in T-Head during 2027 and 2028 would expand capacity and support future growth, according to TheFly.

However, 39 out of 41 analysts covering the stock rate it ‘Buy’ or Strong Buy,’ while two rate the stock ‘Sell’ or ‘Strong Sell,’ according to Koyfin.

Q2 Earnings Precap 

Alibaba reported its September-quarter revenue broadly in line with analyst estimates, while non-GAAP diluted earnings missed expectations. Its AI Cloud and Compute Services revenue grew 53% year-over-year, while adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, and amortization (EBITA) at its E-commerce Group surged 243%.

CEO Eddie Wu said the company's full-stack AI capabilities were supporting stronger commercialization, with recurring revenue from external cloud customers growing 67%. CFO Toby Xu said the company would continue disciplined AI investments focused on returns while targeting positive free cash flow as AI monetization grows.

data.title: GTA 6’s Day-One Sales Were Within Reach Of Morgan Stanley’s Quarterly Target — Firm Says Game ‘Vastly Exceeded’ High Expectations
data.description:
Key points:
  • According to the latest data from Sensor Tower’s sales tracker, GTA 6 saw an estimated 24.58 million copies sold, generating about $2.36 billion in gross sales.
  • GTA V generated $1 billion in the first three days of its launch.
  • Take-Two has yet to release official sales figures, though BofA expects the data by Monday.

Take-Two Interactive’s (TTWO) blockbuster game Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) is already approaching Morgan Stanley’s quarterly sales estimate, with the brokerage saying the game has “vastly exceeded” already high expectations since its launch on Thursday.

According to TheFly, Morgan Stanley maintained an ‘Overweight’ rating and a $280 price target on TTWO shares, implying a 34% upside.

TTWO shares were up 1.3% at the time of writing. But despite the launch of the much-awaited game, the stock is heading for its worst week since August-end.

GTA VI Sales Close In On Morgan Stanley’s Quarterly Target

Morgan Stanley cited Sensor Tower estimates showing GTA VI generated $1.8 billion in gross sales, with about 19 million copies sold, through Thursday morning. The firm said the strong start put its estimate of 30 million copies sold this quarter “within reach on day 1.”

According to the latest data from Sensor Tower’s sales tracker, GTA 6 saw an estimated 24.58 million copies sold, generating about $2.36 billion in gross sales. The estimate, which includes preorders, represents nearly 82% of Morgan Stanley’s quarterly forecast. Take-Two is yet to release official sales figures.

GTA VI Sales More Than Double GTA V

The estimated $2.36 billion already dwarfs the $1 billion generated by its predecessor, GTA V, in the first three days of its launch.

GTA VI has also received exceptional reviews, earning a Metacritic score of 99 out of 100 and tying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, released in 1998, for the platform’s highest-rated game. The game has been reviewed by 151 people on the platform so far. IGN’s Luke Reilly called it “the single most impressive video game I have ever played.”

Last week, BofA estimated that GTA VI needed at least $1.9 billion in sales to meet investors’ fiscal 2027 expectations. Analyst Omar Dessouky expects Take-Two to announce initial sales by November 23, although an announcement as early as Friday could signal particularly strong demand.

data.title: Erasca's pill shrinks hard-to-treat pancreatic and lung tumors in early-stage trial
data.description:
Erasca said on Friday its experimental cancer pill shrank tumors in many patients with advanced pancreatic and lung cancers in an early-stage trial.

  • Of 25 patients with pancreatic cancer taking a 32 mg daily dose of the drug, ERAS-0015, 44% saw tumors shrink significantly, Erasca said

  • In patients with the two most common genetic variations of the disease, the response rate jumped to 69%

  • In lung cancer, 60% of five patients who had already received immunotherapy and chemotherapy responded to the drug

  • ERAS-0015 acts as a "molecular glue" that blocks faulty RAS proteins, effectively shutting down vital signals that cancer cells need to grow and multiply

  • RAS proteins act as 'on-off' switches for cell growth, but can get stuck in the 'on' position when they mutate, driving uncontrolled growth of many common and deadly cancers

  • Erasca said the treatment was generally well tolerated

  • The company had earlier reported one death from lung inflammation in a patient taking a 24 mg dose of the drug

  • Erasca plans to start late-stage clinical trials in both pancreatic and lung cancers in 2027

  • The company said it would also test the drug alongside a second experimental treatment, ERAS-4001, starting in 2027

data.title: Citi underestimated risky assets by $35 billion after incorrectly recording trades, sources say
data.description:
Key points:
  • Error understated risk-weighted assets by about $35 billion at European trading unit, source says
  • Citi says it identified and resolved internal capital modeling issue this summer
  • Citi says it injected capital into European trading subsidiary to restore buffers

By Tatiana Bautzer and Elisa Martinuzzi

Citigroup underestimated its risk-weighted assets after an error in recording some trades, according to people familiar with the matter, forcing the US lender to inject capital into a subsidiary.

It is a setback for the Wall Street firm that is seeking to rapidly address years-long regulatory demands and represents another challenge for Citi CEO Jane Fraser, who has been trying to fix various problems at the bank for years.

Citi has operated under tight supervisory scrutiny in the US, and as recently as the summer was targeting submitting paperwork to regulators this year to get the restrictions lifted, Reuters has reported.

The bank recorded some trades incorrectly at a trading unit in Europe, two people said, underestimating the risk-weighted assets by about $35 billion, one person familiar with the matter said. The stock of such assets is a key measure regulators use to determine how much capital banks need to hold as a buffer for potential losses.

In a statement to Reuters, Citigroup said the bank had identified and resolved an internal capital modeling issue at a European trading subsidiary this summer. "The subsidiary remained fully compliant with regulatory minimums throughout, with no impact on the holding company or main operating bank," the bank said.

"Citi completed remedial actions and injected capital to immediately restore the subsidiary's buffers."

The firm used an internal model based on its own statistical assumptions to measure the riskiness of assets tied to some trades at the UK securities unit, the people said. Regulators had not approved the model for those types of transactions, they added. Once the trades were assessed using a standard risk model, the value of RWAs shot up significantly, the people said.

The Bank of England, which oversees Britain's financial industry alongside the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), said it does not comment on specific firms. FCA did not respond to a request for comment.

The third-largest US bank reported about $1.2 trillion of total RWA in June and September, filings show, indicating the error represented about 2.7% of the total. Reuters could not establish if the bank has already reflected the adjustment to RWA in the reported figures.

CITI'S PROBLEMS

"The perception is not great since the bar is higher for Citi after its prior mistakes," Wells Fargo analysts led by Mike Mayo said in a note to clients, while noting that the mistake was not material from a regulatory perspective.

"Citi messed up, but the standard for banks should not be zero mistakes."

Citi's problems stretch back to 2020, when it was told to remediate longstanding risk management and data governance problems identified by the US Federal Reserve and Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.

The bank was fined $400 million and agreed to a long list of longstanding issues it needed to fix, but was then fined another $136 million in 2024 for the delay in fixing its data management problems.

The Federal Reserve had no comment on the underestimation of RWA when contacted by Reuters. The comptroller could not be immediately reached outside regular business hours.

Shaking off the regulatory shackles would free up resources, become a key achievement for Fraser and bolster Citigroup shares, according to analysts.

The bank has also been reprimanded for breaches in Europe. In 2024, UK regulators fined Citigroup the equivalent of $78.5 million for controls failings in its trading operations, one of the biggest sanctions for systems breaches. In one of the blunders, Citi had caused a sudden fall in European stocks in May 2022.

Separately, Britain's Prudential Regulation Authority, a division of the Bank of England, had fined the bank $56.3 million in 2019 for providing inaccurate financial statements.

data.title: Global equity funds attract inflows for a ninth straight week
data.description:
Global equity funds attracted significant inflows in the week through November 18. Investors found confidence in a strong third-quarter earnings season and easing crude oil prices to build long-term positions, despite a recent surge in volatility among some major technology stocks.

Investors poured a net $59.23 billion into global equity funds during the week, marking their largest weekly net purchase since mid-June, according to LSEG Lipper data.

With about 91% of MSCI All Country World Index constituents having reported, third-quarter earnings grew 31.6%, beating analyst forecasts by about 6.2%.

Concerns over AI spending, along with Democrats' midterm sweep, have, however, raised fears of tighter scrutiny and slower data-center expansion, recently pressuring the technology sector.

"We do not think that the economic expansion, corporate earnings cycle, or structural AI investment story has broken," said Mark Haefele, chief investment officer at UBS Global Wealth Management, in a note.

"Our base case for 2027 remains for economic growth close to trend, rising corporate profits, further growth in AI investment and moderating inflation later in the year."

Investors bought a net $45.71 billion of US equity funds, the largest weekly inflow since September 23. European equity funds also attracted a net $15 billion, while Asian funds saw net outflows of $2.78 billion.

By sector, technology funds attracted a net $12.3 billion. Industrials and gold and other precious-metals funds, however, saw notable outflows of $1.43 billion and $538 million, respectively.

Global bond funds, meanwhile, witnessed a second successive weekly outflow, valued at $3.2 billion.

Dollar-denominated and high-yield bond funds saw notable outflows of $2.78 billion and $1.36 billion, respectively. Euro-denominated bond funds, however, attracted $2.34 billion, their largest weekly inflow since August 12.

Investors, meanwhile, withdrew a net $13.89 billion from money market funds, marking a second consecutive week of outflows.

Among commodity funds, energy funds attracted $260.84 million, extending their streak of net purchases to five straight weeks. Gold and other precious-metals funds also drew a net $152.82 million.

In emerging markets, investors added $1.98 billion to equity funds, marking a seventh consecutive weekly net purchase. Bond funds, however, saw net outflows of $1.38 billion, according to data covering 29,197 funds.

Meanwhile, the annual decline in construction output eased significantly to 0.1 percent from 3.2 percent in the prior month.

On an unadjusted basis, construction production also contracted the same 0.1 percent annually, in contrast to a 1.4 percent rebound in August.
